featured_reviews.review_text:
Joined Cult Gym at Wadala due to proximity where I stay. The gym equipment are good with variety however gym requires following improvements:

1. Availability and engagement of General Trainer - This gym is solely focused on P. T. i.e., Personal Training and at any given time except in morning there is no general trainer on floor to help regular members and instilling gym etiquettes in some unruly and miscreant members which isn’t happening at all. I have gone to Cult gym Prabhadevi where there’s always a general trainer on floor who helps if asked or does proactively and also corrects the persons not following gym etiquettes properly.

2. Management - Management team of the gym is very ineffective and not that strong. We all work for money but a Gym is a holy place for many peoples and it should be handled like a School or College wherein there should be strict discipline and code of conduct which isn’t thing taken seriously in the gym. Members come here to Socialize, hog machines, not keeping dumbbells' / weights / rods in designated place after use, no social sense of presence of other peoples around, wearing headphones and talking loudly, banging weights, etc. I have been to local gyms where though machinery is average and not that high profile, but at least management is strong enough to instill discipline in members.

3. Timings - Gym is operational till 10:30, however most of the good and high profile gyms in our area are open till 11:00 p.m. Gym can be kept open till 11:00 p.m. very effectively without any hesitation.

4. Availability of Steam - Steam is available only on Wednesday’s and Saturday’s which was informed when joined. However sometimes steam is abruptly closed or not available on designated days without any prior notice and just putting up a piece of paper as government circular on notice board on same day.

5. Gym closed on public holidays and Sundays - Gym is closed on many of the public holidays on top of being closed on Sundays. Most of the gyms in Mumbai are either open full day on Sundays or at least for half day till noon. I agree that holidays are part and parcel of every job, but being a cult gym other cult gyms around our areas are open on public holidays and Sundays too.

Conclusion:
I have just joined this gym due to availability of good machinery, fame of Cult and proximity near my residence, however after paying a good hefty yearly fees, overall ambience, vibes and mood is like any other local AC gym in any good area. So think before joining gym just based on exterior appearance and name.
